description_en: Embeds a C2PA digital signature into a user-uploaded image and returns the download URL
description_zh: 对用户上传的图片嵌入C2PA数字签名并返回下载地址
name: SignUserImage

parameters.description_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. The client generates this value. Make sure the value is unique across different requests. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.
parameters.description_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一。ClientToken 只支持 ASCII 字符，且不能超过 64 个字符。
parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. The client generates this value. Make sure the value is unique across different requests. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length

parameters.name: client_token

parameters.description_en: The URL of the image to be signed. HTTP and HTTPS URLs are supported. Specify at least one of `ImageUrl` and `ObjectKey`.
parameters.description_zh: 待签名图片的 URL 地址。支持 HTTP/HTTPS 链接。`ImageUrl` 与 `ObjectKey` 二选一，至少提供一个。
parameters.help_en: The URL of the image to be signed. HTTP and HTTPS URLs are supported. Specify at least one of `ImageUrl` and `ObjectKey`
parameters.help_zh: 待签名图片的 URL 地址。支持 HTTP/HTTPS 链接。`ImageUrl` 与 `ObjectKey` 二选一，至少提供一个
parameters.name: image_url

parameters.description_en: The ObjectKey of the image to be signed in OSS. When you use `ObjectKey`, make sure the key belongs to the namespace of the current caller. Specify at least one of `ImageUrl` and `ObjectKey`.
parameters.description_zh: 待签名图片在 OSS 中的 `ObjectKey`。使用 `ObjectKey` 时需确保该 Key 属于当前调用者的命名空间。`ImageUrl` 与 `ObjectKey` 二选一，至少提供一个。
